messages.subject: plot size not "maintained" by grid.arrange
parts:
Dear all,

I have a problem using the grid.arrange function in the gridExtra package to put multiple plots in one window. I want to plot seven scatterplots (dataset 1) and one barchart (dataset 2), and the latter seems to be compressed laterally (such that you cannot even see the bars!) when I save the image as a pdf. In attach you can find the dput output with the two datasets. Below you can find the code I used to create the plots.

plot.H.poc<-ggplot(div.env,aes(res.POC.SED,res.H.SED))+geom_point()
plot.H.poc<-plot.H.poc+geom_smooth(method="lm",formula=y~poly(x,2),se=F,colour="black")+opts(panel.grid.major=theme_blank(),panel.grid.minor=theme_blank())+labs(x="POC",y="H'")

plot.H.SED<-ggplot(div.env,aes(res.SED.POC,res.H.POC))+geom_point()
plot.H.SED<-plot.H.SED+geom_smooth(method="lm",se=F,colour="black")+opts(panel.grid.major=theme_blank(),panel.grid.minor=theme_blank())+labs(x="SED",y="H'")

plot.J.SVI<-ggplot(div.env,aes(SVI,J))+geom_point()+geom_smooth(se=F,method="lm",colour="black")+labs(y="J'",x="SVI")+opts(panel.grid.major=theme_blank(),panel.grid.minor=theme_blank())

plot.EG18.poc<-ggplot(div.env,aes(res.POC.SVI,res.EG18.SVI))+geom_point()
plot.EG18.poc<-plot.EG18.poc+geom_smooth(method="lm",se=F,colour="black")+opts(panel.grid.major=theme_blank(),panel.grid.minor=theme_blank())+labs(x="POC",y="EG(18)")

plot.EG18.SVI<-ggplot(div.env,aes(res.SVI.POC,res.EG18.POC))+geom_point()
plot.EG18.SVI<-plot.EG18.SVI+geom_smooth(method="lm",se=F,colour="black")+opts(panel.grid.major=theme_blank(),panel.grid.minor=theme_blank())+labs(x="SVI",y="EG(18)")

plot.TD.SED<-ggplot(div.env,aes(SED,TD))+geom_point()+geom_smooth(method="lm",se=F,colour="black")+opts(panel.grid.major=theme_blank(),panel.grid.minor=theme_blank())


plot.MI.SVI<-ggplot(div.env,aes(SVI,MI))+geom_point()+geom_smooth(method="lm",se=F,colour="black")+opts(panel.grid.major=theme_blank(),panel.grid.minor=theme_blank())

varpart.plot<-ggplot(varpart,aes(div,fraction))+geom_bar(colour="black",aes(fill=as.factor(var_expl)))+labs(x="",y="Fraction of variation explained (%)")+opts(panel.grid.major=theme_blank(),panel.rid.minor=theme_blank())+scale_fill_manual(values=c("#F5F5F5","#C0C0C0","#696969","white"),guide=guide_legend(" "))+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,100))+scale_x_discrete(labels=c("EG(18)","H'","J'","MI","TD"))

library(gridExtra)
pdf("div_env.pdf")
grid.arrange(plot.H.poc,plot.H.SED,plot.J.SVI,plot.EG18.poc,plot.EG18.SVI,plot.TD.SED,plot.MI.SVI,varpart.plot,clip=F)
dev.off()



Does anybody know how to solve this problem?

Thanks!
Ellen

sessionInfo()
Mine is below. 

The reason why you're plot is compressed is because it is cramming the plot and the legend into the area you supplied via gridExtra. The best thing to do is to get rid of the legend and your plot will then take up the space. Thanks to Baptiste's good documentation and examples I found this: 

https://code.google.com/p/gridextra/wiki/arrangeGrob

Which allowed me to edit the script. Should work and look snazzy now! 

B
